expr: (() => { const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); const c=k.findIndex(x=>x==='canvas'||/sim-canvas/.test(x)); const b=document.querySelector('#sim-root .controls').firstElementChild; return c>=0 && c<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') && b.tagName==='BUTTON' ? 1 : 0 })()
